gates.description: Incident severity level must be assigned (Sev1-Sev4)
Incident roles must be assigned: IC, Communications Lead, Operations Lead, Scribe
Mitigation must be documented before root cause investigation
Stakeholder communication updates must be documented
Postmortem must be scheduled within 48 hours of incident closure
Incident timeline must be documented with key events

anti_patterns.description: Everyone has equal voice during the incident — no decisions made, debate continues while service is down
Team focuses on understanding why instead of restoring service — investigation before mitigation
No stakeholder updates sent — they learn about the outage from external sources
Incident never formally closes — drifts into follow-ups with no clear ownership or resolution
Attribution and blame assigned during active response — slows resolution and damages trust

escalation_triggers: Sev1 incident not mitigated within 30 minutes
Incident requires access or authority not available to current team
Customer data potentially compromised — escalate to security immediately
Incident caused by a third-party service requiring vendor engagement
Multiple simultaneous incidents suggesting systemic issue or attack
IC reaching decision fatigue — request replacement IC

input_requirements.description: Incident report or alert with initial impact details

output_certifications: Incident roles assigned (IC, Communications, Operations, Scribe)
Mitigation prioritized and documented before root cause investigation
Stakeholder updates sent at defined cadence
Incident ticket updated with full timeline, impact, and resolution
